component_definitions.initial_soc_lower_slack: initial SOC minus reserve, divided by usable SOC width
component_definitions.initial_soc_upper_slack: capacity minus initial SOC, divided by usable SOC width
component_definitions.passive_export_slack: minimum no-battery grid headroom normalized by export limit and gross load/PV magnitude
component_definitions.terminal_reachability_slack: remaining maximum one-direction energy minus terminal SOC need, divided by 500 kWh
